bundle.longDescription: Material Edit is a lightweight, Material Design 3 video editor: multi-track timeline, trim and split, filters, transitions, text, overlays, music, and export to MP4/WebM. Light/dark/system themes, custom accent colors, English and Vietnamese UI.
